description: Canonical role and control_mode strings. Python (server.py) and Forge (BridgeConstants.java) MUST use these exact values.

roles.client: Minecraft game client (ForgeWebSocketClient) - sends local player obs
roles.server: Server-side bridge (ServerBridgeWebSocketClient) - sends fake player obs

control_modes.PLAYER: AI controls local player; expects role=client
control_modes.SERVER_BOT: AI controls server-side fake player; expects role=server
